name: 49935 · Iron River, MI
findings: ZIP 49935 (Iron River) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49935 (Iron River) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49935 (Iron River) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
